WITH s AS (
  SELECT properties.$session_id AS sid,
         countIf(event='affiliate_link_click') AS clicks,
         any(coalesce(nullIf(properties.$session_entry_referring_domain,''),'')) AS ref,
         any(coalesce(nullIf(properties.$session_entry_utm_source,''),'')) AS utm
  FROM events WHERE coalesce(properties.$host,'') = 'easternalignment.com'
  AND coalesce(properties.$geoip_country_code,'') != 'CN'
  AND coalesce(properties.$session_entry_referring_domain,'') NOT IN ('localhost:4321','127.0.0.1:8188','127.0.0.1:8765','localhost:8765','127.0.0.1:8931')
  AND (person_id IS NULL OR toString(person_id) NOT IN ('8435b8d5-16b6-5f4b-9b71-f5d4d196ad00','83b89204-633d-56fa-9e65-202e62d839ff','259d7d34-120f-50a6-a260-3e7fa192ae79','8b444548-d415-5d49-88b2-f717feaba288','b7575d9c-8453-5600-874a-47188ad98ec8','01a0b5bc-770d-7c62-b34d-5416ccb6f386')) AND timestamp >= toDateTime(1789920000) AND timestamp < toDateTime(1790524800)
        AND properties.$session_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY sid
)
SELECT CASE
    WHEN match(concat(coalesce(ref,''),' ',coalesce(utm,'')), '(?i)(chatgpt|openai|perplexity|claude|gemini|copilot|kimi|deepseek|grok)') THEN 'AI助手'
    WHEN match(coalesce(ref,''), '(?i)(google|bing|yahoo|duckduckgo|yandex|ecosia)') THEN '搜索引擎'
    WHEN ref = '$direct' OR coalesce(ref,'') = '' THEN '直接访问'
    ELSE '外链引荐' END AS channel,
  count() AS sessions, sum(clicks) AS total_clicks,
  round(100.0*countIf(clicks>0)/count(),1) AS cvr_pct
FROM s GROUP BY channel ORDER BY sessions DESC LIMIT 20
